body:
This PR fixes surface-callback oscillations under convective gustiness and speeds up the Monin-Obukhov solve by evaluating the profile integrals once per residual evaluation (released as v1.6.0):

1. **Prevent surface-callback oscillations under convective gustiness** ([commit 1](https://github.com/CliMA/SurfaceFluxes.jl/pull/272/changes/b9fae19ed46499c054a8d142e51f1e267b0f105b)):
   - At low wind with `FlooredDeardorffGustinessSpec(0)`, the convective gustiness drops to zero as the surface virtual potential temperature crosses the air value ($\Delta\theta_v = 0$). A single Newton callback step for the surface temperature can overshoot that threshold and bounce between the dry-adiabatic and convective branches, leaving the Monin-Obukhov residual discontinuous and preventing convergence.
   - `evaluate_monin_obukhov_residual` now advances the surface callbacks in two stages per $\zeta$ evaluation (`step_surface_callbacks`): when two callback steps jump across or stay on the convective branch, the fixed point of $T_{\mathrm{sfc}}(g_h(T_{\mathrm{sfc}}))$ along $g_h^2 \propto \max(\Delta\theta_v, 0)$ is solved by a quadratic equation (with a secant step in all other cases), and the state bulk Richardson number and wind speed are evaluated at the updated surface state.
   - `solve_monin_obukhov` evaluates the surface callbacks one final time at the converged $\zeta$ so the returned surface temperature, humidity, and fluxes are mutually consistent.
   - `free_convection_wind_speed` returns zero for $\zeta > 0$, where the boundary layer is stable regardless of the pre-callback surface state.

2. **Evaluate the profiles and surface state once per residual evaluation to improve performance** ([commit 2](https://github.com/CliMA/SurfaceFluxes.jl/pull/272/changes/55fb9e4fad55b0e74c69a433321530afa25d9f73)):
   - The momentum and heat profile coefficients $\phi_m = \kappa/\widehat{F}_m(\zeta_{\mathrm{eff}})$ and $\phi_h = \kappa/\widehat{F}_h(\zeta_{\mathrm{eff}})$ at the capped stability parameter are computed once per residual evaluation (`with_profile_coefficients`) and reused across `compute_ustar`, `free_convection_wind_speed`, `heat_conductance`, `exchange_coefficients`, and the profile bulk Richardson number $\zeta \phi_m^2 / (\kappa \phi_h)$.
   - When the friction velocity is computed from the wind speed, `heat_conductance` returns $u_\star \phi_h$ directly inside the solve instead of dividing by the wind speed to form $C_h$ and multiplying back.
   - `surface_state` evaluates the surface density, virtual potential temperatures, effective wind speed, and $u_\star$ once per callback stage, and the interior virtual potential temperature is computed once per solve (`with_interior_virtual_pottemp`).
   - Together these cut GPU execution time by ~33–45% across single-surface and land-skin solves while preserving identical results on existing test cases.
title: Prevent surface-callback oscillations and hoist profile evaluations
